power_system.name: Chakra
power_system.mechanics: Chakra is formed by combining physical and spiritual energy. Ninja shape it into jutsu. Five basic natures: Fire, Water, Earth, Wind, Lightning. Advanced: Kekkei Genkai (bloodline limits), Tailed Beast chakra, Sage Mode (Nature Energy).

factions.name: Akatsuki
factions.note: Not yet public threat in early Pre-Part-I

key_characters.name: Naruto Uzumaki
key_characters.personality: Hyperactive, desperately craves recognition, acts before thinking, fiercely loyal, hides loneliness behind bravado
key_characters.speech_pattern: Enthusiastic, uses 'dattebayo' verbal tic, informal, simple vocabulary

key_characters.name: Sasuke Uchiha
key_characters.personality: Brooding, obsessed with revenge, competitive, respect must be earned not given, cold exterior over grief
key_characters.speech_pattern: Terse, formal, dismissive of those he considers weak
key_characters.tragedy: Itachi massacred his clan - Sasuke witnessed it

key_characters.name: Hinata Hyuga
key_characters.personality: Deeply shy, self-doubting, extremely perceptive, admires inner strength over raw power, quietly determined
key_characters.speech_pattern: Soft, hesitant, often trails off, formal honorifics
key_characters.note: Byakugan heiress, complex relationship with Neji and her father

key_characters.name: Shikamaru Nara
key_characters.personality: Genius-level IQ hidden behind deliberate laziness, deeply loyal once trust is earned, resents being forced to apply himself
key_characters.note: Best friendship candidate for strategic MC - mutual respect of intellect

key_characters.name: Kakashi Hatake
key_characters.personality: Perpetually late, reads Icha Icha in public, deceptively observant, haunted by loss of his team, takes lives seriously when stakes are real
key_characters.speech_pattern: Casual, indirect, deflects personal questions with non-answers
key_characters.note: Possible mentor - will test MC rigorously before extending any trust

key_characters.name: Itachi Uchiha
key_characters.personality: Calm, extraordinarily perceptive, acts from love while appearing cruel, carries impossible burdens alone
key_characters.note: Critical tragedy prevention target - massacre happens when he is ~13

forbidden_before_canon_trigger: Sharingan (requires emotional trauma or specific training)
Mangekyou Sharingan (requires witnessing death of closest person)
Rasengan (Minato's secret technique - not publicly known)
